steps.section: 0) ESPN schedule refresh + TBD patch + parity
2) Fetch odds snapshots for 2025-12-02 and build last/closing lines
3) Build daily results (reconcile vs finals) for 2025-12-02
3a) Fetch previous day raw scores (no cache) and boxscores
4) Update model tuning from recent daily results
5) Retrain baseline models on latest features_all.csv
6) Fetch today's schedule, odds, and run predictions/picks
7) Filter merged last odds to today's slate
7b) Align predictions to period and compute edges
9) Generate calibrated distributional stake sheet (if distributional columns present)
10) Compare baseline vs calibrated stake sheets
11) Commit and push updated data files
